analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($596.22) vs SMA5($619.91)/SMA20($622.65)/SMA50($678.33): Diagnosing short-to-mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100($639.03)/SMA200($628.43): Indicating a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (29.3%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (42.1→36.7): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.8675→0.0392): Improving but still in negative territory.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $597.05): Approaching lower band, band width narrowing at 8.22%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($594.81): Positioned above the 20-day low ($583.80).
· Swing Resistance ($605.81): First resistance level on a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low ($595.79) > 20-day low ($583.80) indicating an attempt to defend the low, but no Higher Low formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.26x): Increased volume accompanying recent decline, raising confidence in the move.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Downtrend continuation, awaiting confirmation of 594.81 support before considering action.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가($595.79)가 20일 저가($583.80)보다 높아 저점 방어 시도 중이나, 명확한 Higher Low 패턴은 미형성 상태.
